name: Doğan Akdoğan
bio:
Doğan Akdoğan was born in 1987. He graduated from the Theater Department at the Pera Academy of Fine Arts and the Open Education Faculty’s Public Administration program at Anadolu University. He worked as an actor at various theaters for many years. He continues his work as an actor and director at Tiyatro Dan, of which he is a founding member. In addition to theater, he appears as an actor and screenwriter in television series, comedy shows, and feature films.

His work in children’s programming began with hosting and voice-over roles in children’s shows such as “Yarışçı,” “Yarışçı Arazi,” “Tel Ali,” and “Tilki,” which aired on the TRT Çocuk channel. This was followed by his work as a creative drama and theater instructor for children, a role he continues to this day. In recent years, he has served as a host for the documentary series “Big Dreams, Big Projects” and “Zero Waste,” which aired on TRT Documentary. Since 2023, he has been writing for children.
